Carved as one continuous coil: the pegbox back runs on into the outer turn of the scroll and the cheeks' front edges run through the throat into the spiral step. Side profile, spiral and back widths follow a generic luthier's template (makingtheviolin.com, after Vojtěch Blahout), used for proportions only and scaled by 0.99 so the scroll top meets the 590 mm overall length; chin shape designed. About 41 mm across the eyes; eye boss size, step depth and hollowed turns matched by eye to Primavera 150 photo 05. Not a measurement of a Primavera head.
